kind: Race history WeChat Page VM user journeys; fixtures only, no business data writes; not a device test

checks.name: Growth and memory display the returned private history, year filters and actual review scope
Manual entries can save a finished experience without a time, with personal story and tags
Race and city search combines with year filters in both views and resets across accounts
DNF and DNS clear stale finish times; malformed times do not submit or erase a draft
Clock validation matches the 72 hour contract and rejects net time after gun time
Growth nodes explain recorded beginnings, first distances and comparable improvements without assuming an absolute first race
Import requires selection and a separate per race acknowledgement; failures retain edited candidates
Unrecognized or conflicting projects remain unselected even after acknowledgement, until the runner chooses the actual project
Actual text parsing keeps splits and aid-station intervals unresolved while an explicit five-kilometre project remains valid
Actual parsing preserves all separate project evidence while invalid earlier fields cannot veto a clear project
Candidates support trail, online and DNF corrections before any PB eligible data is saved
OCR only selects or uploads after explicit consent for this action, using the current legal version
Several OCR files keep successful text and explain failed images without saving originals
Account switching discards late OCR, detail and list responses and clears drafts and private URLs
The latest detail wins; a detail error can retry the same encoded private identity
Expired authentication clears all private state and authentication before retrying
Only own private media URLs get a token; inherited videos stay out of image preview and covers
Uploading a separate private souvenir uses its kind and never reuses OCR consent
New souvenir deletion is confirmed; deleting a legacy entry clearly preserves original results
Text file cancellation and read errors keep previous source and reviewed candidates
Portable JSON export excludes authenticated media links, and temporary export files are cleaned
JSON and CSV exports retain unknown timing, source hashes, personal tags and multiline quoted stories on actual server reimport
A write in flight is submitted once; changing text cannot replace its candidate draft
Registered mini entrances preserve runner pages and expose no charging or identity lookup flow
